author: GamingBolt
description:
Sure, it wouldn’t exactly be accurate to call Final Fantasy Resonance innovating or subversive in any way- what you see is exactly what you get here. 

But what you’re getting is a well design, addictive, mechanically deep, and expansive old school RPG that genre fans absolutely will not want to miss, especially if you have a soft spot for the golden age of SNES and PS1 role playing games. 

The wait for an HD-2D Final Fantasy title has been a long one, and the one for a major brand new turn based entry in the franchise even longer, but thankfully, Final Fantasy Resonance is well worth the wait on both those fronts.
title: Final Fantasy Resonance Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
GTA 6 is now officially a month away. While it’s hard to shake the nagging feeling that another delay might jump out at us from the shadows, a part of us is excited at the thought of playing a game on November 19 we once thought we were not going to see. 

There are so many things we’ve hoped to see, or perhaps wished for, along with so many questions that no amount of promos can answer. As a title that carries high expectations, we believe GTA 6 could be at its best when you start playing at launch day, perhaps slowly growing into the title you always dreamed of as you uncover more of its layers.
title: GTA 6 Is Just One Month Away - And It Still Doesn’t Feel Real
